描述_EN: the marks around the edges indicate that this piece was used for upholstery. silks such as these were used both as furnishing fabrics and as dress material. unlike dye, paint does not penetrate into the fibres of the fabric and so easily rubs off, so this would not have been a very durable material. this fragment of cream satin was painted in china for the export market.
描述_ZN: 边缘的痕迹表明这块缎子是用来做装饰品的。 像这样的绸缎既被用作家具面料，也被用作服装材料。 与染料不同，油漆不会渗透到织物的纤维中，因此很容易被擦掉，所以这不会是一种非常耐用的材料。 这块奶油色的绸缎碎片是在中国为出口市场而画的。
